Title: Question about The Framing + Daring the Dawn

Messages.Author: nac.s...@gmail.com
Messages.Body:
I´m not sure about a combination so I ask ask before deckbulding
(once a week)

Is the combat generated by The Framing adjustable to the "resulting
combat" phrasing of Dawn Operation?

Minion A, who previously played the Framing, do something, get
blocked, plays Dawn Operation and watches how the morning annoy the
blocker and the framed.

Legal, not legal?

Dawn Operation

If this action is blocked, all damage inflicted to all vampires in the
resulting combat is aggravated. Any vampire attempting to block may
now choose not to block.

As above, but vampires attempting to block cannot back out.

Framing, The

+1 stealth action. Requires an anarch.

(D) Put this card on the acting anarch and choose a ready minion. If
the anarch with this card is blocked, this card is burned. Then the
blocking minion enters combat with the chosen minion instead of this
anarch (or the action ends with no combat if that combat cannot occur).

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
nac.s...@gmail.com wrote:
> I´m not sure about a combination so I ask ask before deckbulding
> (once a week)
>
> Is the combat generated by The Framing adjustable to the "resulting
> combat" phrasing of Dawn Operation?

No.

> Minion A, who previously played the Framing, do something, get
> blocked, plays Dawn Operation and watches how the morning annoy the
> blocker and the framed.
>
> Legal, not legal?

Legal to play, but Dawn Operation won't affect the replacement combat generated
by The Framing.
